## Executive Summary
Bibek Bhattarai is a software engineer and technologist known for architecting mobile ecosystems, enterprise logistics platforms, and clinical telemetry systems. His work bridges enterprise distributed software engineering, biostatistical healthcare diagnostics, and strategic business operations. He is the founder and lead engineer of Machhamart and has published multiple specialized applications on Google Play.

---

## Verified Applications on Google Play

### 1. Machhamart
- **Package Name**: `com.machhamart`
- **Status**: Production (Live on Google Play Store)
- **Category**: E-Commerce & Aquaculture Logistics
- **Play Store URL**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.machhamart
- **Description**: Nepal's premier aquaculture supply-chain and direct seafood marketplace mobile app. Connects fisheries directly to commercial restaurants and consumers with real-time cold-chain vehicle dispatch, dynamic catch-weight pricing, automated inventory reconciliation, and integrated digital payment gateways (eSewa / Khalti).
- **Core Technologies**: Flutter, Android, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Google Maps Routing API.

### 2. Android Health
- **Package Name**: `com.mobilehealth.droidpulse.mobile_health`
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Category**: Health IT, Clinical Diagnostics & Vitals Telemetry
- **Description**: Clinical telemetry and on-device physiological diagnostics platform. Powered by the proprietary DroidPulse telemetry engine for real-time vitals monitoring, quantitative biostatistical anomaly detection, cryptographic edge storage, and HL7 FHIR clinical record synchronization.
- **Core Technologies**: Android Kotlin, DroidPulse Telemetry Core, HL7 FHIR APIs, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Room Database.

### 3. Search Everything
- **Package Name**: `com.devicefinder.app.device_finder`
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Category**: System Utilities & Storage Indexing
- **Description**: Ultra-fast Android system indexing and file search engine delivering sub-50ms query latency across internal flash memory, SD cards, application assets, and document archives with SQLite FTS5 full-text indexing and boolean pattern matching.
- **Core Technologies**: Android Kotlin, C++ NDK, SQLite FTS5 Engine, Storage Access Framework (SAF), Kotlin Coroutines.

### 4. 3D MS Trader
- **Package Name**: `com.mstrader.com`
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Category**: FinTech & Market Analytics
- **Description**: Algorithmic financial market analytics and charting platform for quantitative traders. Offers real-time market data visualization, depth-of-market indicators, algorithmic trading signals, multi-asset portfolio tracking, and mathematical position sizing.
- **Core Technologies**: Android Java/Kotlin, Financial Charting Engine, WebSocket/REST Streaming, SQLite Local Cache.

## Academic Education & University Degrees
Bibek Bhattarai holds a distinctive multi-disciplinary academic background uniting computer science, clinical medicine, educational statistics, and enterprise business:

1. **Bachelor Degree in Education (B.Ed - 4 Years)**
   - **Institution**: Tribhuvan University (TU), Sanothimi Campus, Bhaktapur, Nepal
   - **Duration**: 2017 – 2021 (Completed)
   - **Specialization**: Foundation of Health & Physical Education, Educational Statistics, Quantitative Measurement, Research Methodology.
   - **Thesis/Focus**: Quantitative Evaluation of Health Indicators and Statistical Frameworks in Public Institutions.

2. **Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
   - **Institution**: Pokhara University (PU), Graduate School of Business, Nepal
   - **Duration**: 2024 – Present (Currently Enrolled / Ongoing)
   - **Specialization**: Enterprise Strategic Management, Quantitative Decision Analytics, Healthcare Systems Operations, Scalable Technology Leadership.

3. **BSc (Hons) Computing**
   - **Institution**: London Metropolitan University, School of Computing and Digital Media, UK
   - **Duration**: 2018 – 2021 (Completed)
   - **Specialization**: Enterprise Distributed Software Architecture, Relational & NoSQL Database Optimization, Cloud Engineering, Information Security & Cryptography.

4. **Diploma in General Medicine (Health Assistant - HA)**
   - **Institution**: Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT), Nepal
   - **Duration**: 2014 – 2017 (Clinical Diploma Completed)
   - **Specialization**: Clinical diagnostics, patient triage, epidemiology, biostatistics, community preventive healthcare.

5. **School Leaving Certificate (SLC)**
   - **Institution**: Government of Nepal Board of Examination (2014, Completed with Distinction)
   - **Focus**: Advanced Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Applications.
